Peter Betkoski (D) }} [[File:BeaconFallsCT HomeWoolenCompany.jpg|thumb|Home Woolen Company, Beacon Falls, Connecticut]] '''Beacon Falls''' is a town in western [[New Haven County, Connecticut]], United States. The town is part of the [[Naugatuck Valley Planning Region, Connecticut|Naugatuck Valley Planning Region]] and is approximately six miles from [[Waterbury, Connecticut|Waterbury]]. It lies in the southwestern part of the state, and is bisected by the [[Naugatuck River]]. The population was 6,000 at the [[2020 United States census|2020 census]], down from 6,049 at the [[2010 United States Census|2010 census]].{{cite web |url=https://data.census.gov/cedsci/profile?g=0600000US0900903250|title=Census - Geography Profile: Beacon Falls town, New Haven County, Connecticut|access-date=November 26, 2021}}
